title: A welcome email
brief:
A welcome email for people who just signed up to Orbit. Write the copy yourself.

It has:

- the Orbit logo, https://assets.orbit.dev/img/orbit-logo.png (a 252×128 file)
- a greeting with the reader's first name, from the merge tag `first_name`
- three steps to get started
- a button to https://orbit.dev/start

It should look good on desktop and on phones.
